summary: Hand-written workflow commands: diagnose, overview, templates pull/push/render, suppressions check, bounces reactivate/resend-blocked, webhooks/domains/streams health, service-status, and their shared helpers.
reason: Recipient triage, templates as code, and bounce hygiene need multi-call flows the endpoint mirrors do not provide. They are registered through novel command hooks and call the real API.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes, including symlink refusal for template check and pull, prune deletes held after a failed upload, harness refusal for email sends, webhook URL redaction, and the P2 regressions in postmark_review_fixes_test.go.
